newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle market not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle market not well established - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with a few sales slaughter steers steady, but not well established, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.

Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and no slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 37,100 head including 20,600 head or about 56 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 65.00.
